label: 全部为实测；2026-11-05 final release（用户库/索引库拆分 + 文件级索引切换）重跑了启动、内存和索引流水线；索引微基准仍是 Store 层解析/写入成本。安装包体积为文件字节数换算；侧栏 UI 与可读性数字见 sidebarUi/readabilityAudit。

startup.note: window-visible and app-ready are not pixel-on-screen; app-ready is after the first note DOM and invoke. forceGraph.method: GraphView.build() performance.now() inside the 2026-11-05 release WebView2 156, 1456x939; includes 320 force ticks, rectangle/circle collision relaxation, DOM construction and first fit; excludes CSS first-frame paint. Repeated via tools/measure-force-many.mjs; corpus from tools/make-bench-vault.mjs.
forceGraph.note: The 200-note build blocks the click for its duration; there is no worker and no post-build rAF loop. Default is recent 40 for legibility, not because 80/200 fail performance. Timings were re-measured after the card size changed from 148x44 to 184x56.

sidebarAcceptance.method: tools/verify-sidebar.mjs drives the 2026-11-05 release window over CDP (port 9222); temp 6-note vault with one empty root folder, one empty nested folder, a link source and a target without front-matter id; drags and key presses are synthetic DragEvent/KeyboardEvent
covered: empty root folder 归档 and nested 研究/空目录 are visible
create note writes front-matter id; create folder; inline rename
drag a note into a new folder; drag the link source into 研究
rename rewrites [[目标笔记]] to [[目标笔记-改名]]
moving the target rewrites the source relative link to 归档/...
moving the source re-relativizes it to ../归档/...
rename and move keep notes.id and annotations.note_id unchanged
delete moves the note into .trash; undo within 8s restores it
opened the moved note: 1 annotation, 0 orphaned
sidebarAcceptance.limits: synthetic DOM events, not a physical mouse drag; one 8s undo window; 6-note vault; no 1k/10k sidebar run
sidebarAcceptance.evidence: shots/accept-01-start.png, accept-02-annotated.png, accept-03-moved.png, accept-04-deleted.png, accept-05-final.png; docs/experiment-log.txt

shortBody10k.note: make-bench-vault short synthetic notes; not comparable to the 1.5k-char body runs

indexingPipeline.method: tools/probe-swap-reads.mjs and tools/probe-index-lock.mjs on the final 2026-11-05 release; 10k copies of the real sample body (81MB) switched in, then sample-vault switched back; reads sampled roughly every 20ms

switch10k.note: staging build itself does not block reads; the swap is a file rename (122-128ms). The max search is the first query against the newly swapped FTS (cold page cache), not the swap transaction.

indexingPipeline.watcherNote: 450ms debounce + about 38ms parse/write; 10k single-file not measured
implementation: Store: yebian.sqlite holds annotations/settings; the index connection opens yebian-index.sqlite and ATTACHes the user DB
IndexService actor writes only the index DB; staging is a full index file
set_vault/reindex close the writer and Store read connection, rename staging over live, reopen and attach user, with yebian-index.old as rollback
startup/watcher/file operations update only changed paths
15-minute full stat reconciliation as a watcher backstop
indexingPipeline.limits: first search after a 10k switch is cold (1.28-1.53s), then p95 2-5ms; list waits up to 0.29s during connection reopen; 50k/100k not measured; no background incremental FTS merge; .old rename under antivirus/file locks not stress-tested
